From: Lauren Cho <contracts@datasafe.co>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: DataSafe — insurance packet for PO setup

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the warm intro. Attached are our standard onboarding documents to get the PO and vendor record created: Certificate of Insurance (COI), subcontractor list, and a short cyber liability summary.

Quick bullets: 
- Limits: GL $2M per occurrence / $4M aggregate; Auto $1M; Professional liability $2M.
- We can add Redwood Inference as additional insured with a 30-day notice provision — we typically do a blanket endorsement.
- Subcontractors: attached list includes two named subvendors used for deployment support; they carry similar coverage.

Attachments: [attachment: DataSafe_COI.pdf (PDF, 112KB)], [attachment: DataSafe_Subcontractor_List.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)], [attachment: DataSafe_Cyber_Liability_Summary.pdf (PDF, 54KB)]

If anything is missing or you'd like a tailored endorsement, loop me in and I can coordinate with our broker.

Thanks,
Lauren Cho
Contracts Manager
DataSafe Labs, Inc.
lauren.cho@datasafe.co

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Cho <contracts@datasafe.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DataSafe — insurance packet for PO setup

Thanks Lauren — received and appreciate the quick turnaround. 

Karthik / Marissa — assigning to procurement + risk to validate scope for a conditional PO. A few quick asks before we can clear to finance: 

1) Can Lauren confirm whether the additional insured endorsement names "Redwood Inference, Inc." exactly as spelled? We need the wording for the COI to match our procurement template.
2) Is there a waiver of subrogation on the GL/Auto policies?
3) On subcontractors: are any of the listed subvendors located outside the US? If so we need their certificates too.

If we don't need a custom endorsement, a signed COI with the exact name + endorsement reference should get us to conditional PO. Please advise if Legal needs to review the PL wording.

Action: Lauren — can you confirm 1–3 and re-send an updated COI if needed?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Procurement (Contracting)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Hi Stephanie — quick answers below: 

1) Yes, endorsement can name "Redwood Inference, Inc." exactly; I attached a redlined endorsement from our broker that contains the naming.
2) We can confirm waiver of subrogation for GL but need to request it on Auto — should be fine but will confirm.
3) The two subcontractors are both US-based (TX & CA) and I included an indicator column in the subcontractor list. If you want their COIs we can pull them and include with the package.
